migration.note: Backward-compatible watchdog fix. No config, schema, secret, or environment migration is required. Existing sites remain pinned until an owner approves an explicit upgrade.

verification.evidence: The required API unit suite covers persistent low, recovered low, and errored confirmation results. Publication requires the complete clean-checkout release suite.

publication.requirement: Run pnpm release:prepare from a clean committed checkout, record the validated commit and evidence hashes, then create a new annotated kit-v2.0.1 tag. Never move or overwrite an existing tag.

upgradePolicy: Projects pin an exact kit tag. Upgrades are explicit and never automatic.
